data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall flow right (Booking search, then the xe.com EUR conversion, then the mail draft, with the correct subject and body templates), but it has two serious problems: the hotel choice is a vague 'well-rated' instead of 'first hotel with a review score of 8 or more', and the last step says Send when the true workflow forbids sending and requires Discard. It also splits traveler into separate recipient and recipient_name parameters without saying that the address is {traveler}@example.com.
